title: How Network Topology and Data Heterogeneity Shape Decentralized Learning: A Spectral Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.26104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Network topology influences decentralized federated learning through information mixing and the relative contribution of individual nodes. While existing analyses primarily focus on spectral mixing properties, they often assume doubly stochastic aggregation, overlooking topology-dependent influence under irregular communication networks. We develop a spectral framework that separates two complementary mechanisms: the dominant eigenmode determines the consensus trajectory and node influence, while non-dominant eigenmodes govern the propagation and attenuation of disagreement. Under uniform neighborhood averaging, we show that the stationary influence is proportional to node degree plus one and derive a bound relating model disagreement to spectral mixing and gradient heterogeneity. translated_title: 网络拓扑与数据异质性如何塑造去中心化学习：一种谱分析
translated_abstract: 网络拓扑通过信息混合和各节点的相对贡献影响去中心化联邦学习。现有分析主要关注谱混合特性，通常假设双随机聚合，忽视了在不规则通信网络下依赖于拓扑的节点影响力。我们开发了一个谱分析框架，将两种互补机制分离开来：主导特征模态决定共识轨迹和节点影响力，而非主导特征模态控制分歧的传播与衰减。在均匀邻域平均的条件下，我们证明平稳影响力与“节点度加一”成正比，并推导出一个将模型分歧与谱混合特性及梯度异质性相关联的界。随后，我们研究了这些机制如何与节点间的数据分布相互作用。在规则与异构网络拓扑上的实验揭示了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个谱分析框架，揭示去中心化学习中的两个互补机制——主导特征模态决定共识轨迹与节点影响力（平稳影响力正比于节点度加一），非主导特征模态控制分歧的传播与衰减——并推导出模型分歧与谱混合及梯度异质性之间关系的界。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a spectral framework separating two complementary mechanisms in decentralized learning—the dominant eigenmode determines the consensus trajectory and node influence (stationary influence proportional to node degree plus one), while non-dominant eigenmodes govern disagreement propagation—and derives a bound relating model disagreement to spectral mixing and gradient heterogeneity.
